After that, I want to go to another chess club named 'Rook Corner' in Philadelphia, again taking the fastest route. Finally, I want to return home, but this time I want to take the shortest route. Can you also provide me with the details of the events hosted by both chess clubs?"

method.description: The method to use when calculating the route (default is 'fastest').
